title: fix(runtime,mcp): list_actions marks an organization action the caller's membership role does not reach
body:
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_ Fixes #32163 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:普通成员的 AI 通过 MCP `list_actions` 看到的 15 个组织类身份动作(邀请成员、移除成员、改组织、管团队等)仍然列出,但每行带上 `unavailable` 标记,写明需要哪种组织角色(如"需要组织 owner、admin 或 delegated admin")。owner、admin(邀请类还有 delegated admin)看到的列表不变。 - 为什么改:这些动作成员一执行就被组织端点 403 拒绝,AI 却以为能用,白白规划、浪费轮次。按裁决 E「列出并标记,不隐藏」处理。 - 风险与回滚:只多一个标记;谁能执行完全不变(两个执行门都不读这个标记,实测 main 与本分支执行结果逐一相同)。删 SSO 提供方、删 OAuth 应用、建组织这 3 个按记录所有者或部署形态判定的动作不标记。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` 的 `membershipReachRefusal` 与 `listActions` 里 `refusal` 那一行的顺序;`packages/runtime/src/platform-admin-action-gate.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/platform-admin-action-gate.test.ts`,预期 16 passed。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes - **The mark.** `listActions` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) asks a new module function, `membershipReachRefusal(action, objectName, ec)`, after the two existing refusals: `confirmation ?? apiForwardCredentialRefusal(...) ?? membershipReachRefusal(...)`. That is the order `run_action` meets them: the confirmation gate in the admission sequence, the forward's credential table before the target is called, and the organization endpoint last. - **Where the reach comes from.** The function reads the action's declared `target`. When it is an organization endpoint under the auth base path (`/api/v1/auth/organization/...`), the grades that reach it are the union of the grades of every `MEMBERSHIP_REACH` row naming that endpoint (`@objectstack/spec/identity`, the table plugin-auth's `membership-reach-table.test.ts` pins equal to the vendor doors). `/organization/update-member-role` is two rows, so its reach is their union. No local list, and no new stored key: the reach is derived from what survives on the served action (its `target`), so ruling A's key is not needed. - **Whose grades.** The caller's `positions` in the organization the listing reads, by the names `mapMembershipRole` projects the grades to (`org_owner`, `org_admin`, `delegated_admin`). That is the reading the actions' `requiresMembershipReach` sugar is lowered to. Only an envelope that carries its own positions is judged: the system context, a delegated agent (its envelope carries the agent ceiling, `positions: []`, not the person's grades) and an envelope with no `positions` array are left unmarked. - **The mark's shape.** `unavailable: { code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED', reason }`. The code is the one `run_action` answered for a member on every set-A/B action measured on a booted showcase (below). The reason names the action, the roles that reach it and the endpoint, and says who can run it: "Action 'invite_user' on 'sys_member' needs an organization owner, admin or delegated admin: its endpoint (/organization/invite-member) refuses every other membership role, and your role in this organization is none of those. Ask a person who holds one of those roles to run it." - **Nothing hidden, no run change.** Every action stays listed. Neither run door reads the mark: `run_action` and `POST /actions` forward the call to the endpoint exactly as before, and the endpoint stays the authority (a call naming another organization is judged there). - **System-context page.** Row 62b on `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` owns the mark's system-context skip (an elevation read the census counts), and the generated site register names `mcp.ts#membershipReachRefusal`. - **Published page.** `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`: the `list_actions` row names the three codes a listed action can carry (`UNAUTHENTICATED`, `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, and `PERMISSION_DENIED` for the membership grade), and the intro and "What gets exposed" sentences no longer say every listed action can be run. - **Wording.** `McpActionSummary.unavailable`'s JSDoc and the `list_actions` tool description (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) name the membership-role case and its code, and the description no longer promises that every returned action can be run ("that the caller's permissions allow are returned"; "cannot be run by you as you are connected (your credential, or your role in this organization)"). The served skill (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`) no longer says "only those … you are permitted to run" and says what `unavailable` means. Its Console mirror (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts`) carries the same bytes, as its two drift pins require. **Not marked (sets C and D, listed and refused at their door as today):** `sys_sso_provider.delete_sso_provider` and `sys_oauth_application.delete_oauth_application` (judged on record ownership), and `sys_organization.create_organization` (judged on the deployment's tenancy posture; measured on the showcase: `403 ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED`). No reach row names their endpoints, so the function answers `undefined` for them. ## Tests New top-level `describe('[ruling E] list_actions marks an organization action the caller's membership role does not reach')` in `packages/runtime/src/platform-admin-action-gate.test.ts`, the identity-action harness: the REAL identity declarations (`@objectstack/platform-objects/identity`) through the production `McpActionBridge`, with the forward target faked as the endpoints answer a refused role. 1. Premise: every pinned action is AI-exposed, `api`-typed, and declares no capability gate. 2. A plain member (`positions: ['org_member', 'everyone']`) is listed every set-A and set-B action, each marked `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the reason naming "owner or admin" (set A) or "owner, admin or delegated admin" and `/organization/invite-member` (set B). 3. Owner and admin get no mark on any of the 15; delegated_admin gets none on set B and keeps it on set A. 4. CONTROL: the set-C and set-D actions are listed unmarked, for the member and the admin. 5. CONTROL: a delegated agent and the system context are left unmarked. 6. CONTROL: `run_action` unchanged. For each of the 15, the member's call is forwarded (the fake endpoint is called once, so no door refused first) and refused with the endpoint's `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 and its sentence; the admin's call is forwarded once and served. Green at `main` too. Red at `main` (test file at this branch, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` restored from `28a2f0f5`): 2 failed / 14 passed (cases 2 and 3: no mark). Green here: 16 / 16.
Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty after each; the suite imports ./http-dispatcher.js from src, so no dist/ sits between mutation and run) | Mutation | Red | | --- | --- | | A: the caller's grades never reach (`if (false) return undefined;`) | case 3 | | B: the mark not asked in `listActions` (`?? undefined`) | cases 2 and 3 | | C: a delegated agent and the system context judged too | case 5 | | D: reach from every row, not the rows naming the endpoint | cases 2, 3 and 4 | | E: hide instead of mark (`if (!served \|\| membershipReachRefusal(...)) continue;`) | cases 2, 3 (and the run control at the first test revision) |
Live measurement on a booted showcase (temporary dogfood file, not committed; MCP over the session bearer of a signed-up plain member and of the administrator) At `origin/main` `28a2f0f5`: the member is listed 34 `sys_*` actions, all 18 of sets A–D among them, none marked; the administrator 44. As the member, `run_action` answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the endpoint's own sentence on 14 of the 15 set-A/B actions ("You are not allowed to invite users to this organization", "… to delete this member", "… to update this organization", "… to create teams in this organization", …). `cancel_invitation` answered `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` "Member not found": the only invitation row the fixture holds belongs to another organization, so the endpoint stops before its role check. Set C/D: `create_organization` `403 ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED`; the two deletes `404` (no such provider or client in the fixture). At this branch (`d4df05f4`, after the rebuild): the member is listed the same 34, the 15 set-A/B rows marked `PERMISSION_DENIED` and nothing else; the administrator the same 44, none marked. Every member `run_action` answer is identical to `main`'s, code, status and sentence. Records: `measure-main-28a2f0f5.json` and `measure-head-d4df05f4.json` in the seat's `out/32163/`.
## Acceptance notes - **Surface.** Ruling grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over the edited files: `mcp.ts` 17 hits, `mcp-http-tools.ts` 39, `skill-md.ts` 1, none in or governing `listActions`, the `unavailable` JSDoc or the `list_actions` description and skill lines; the one adjacent is the `run_action` listed-check ("maintainer's ruling on the card: no bypass"), which this change does not touch. - **What the mark reads is the courtesy reading, not the door's.** It reads `positions`, as the lowered `visible` predicate does. Two edges where it can differ from the endpoint, both in the safe direction for running (the mark never stops a run): a position granted directly through `sys_user_position` under a grade name (no mark, the endpoint still refuses, as today); a `sys_member` row outside its ADR-0091 validity window (no position, so marked, while the vendor may still admit). With no active organization, every membership's grades count, so a caller who is an admin anywhere is not marked. - **The code.** `PERMISSION_DENIED` is a constant beside the function, typed as the registered vocabulary. It is what `run_action` answered for a member on the showcase; the reason is this listing's own sentence, not the endpoint's (each endpoint words its refusal differently, and the table does not carry them). - **REST `/actions` listing** is not changed: the ruling scopes the mark to MCP `list_actions`. ## Verification
Package suites, typecheck, lint (at `056f314d`; later commits are docs-only) After the last merge of `main` (`056f314d`), on a fresh install and a full build (declarations included) of the `@objectstack/runtime...`, `@objectstack/mcp...` and `@objectstack/service-storage...` closures: | Run | Result | | --- | --- | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run` | 601 files, 11956 passed, 19 skipped | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run` | 64 files, 1145 passed | | `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.test.ts` | 13 passed | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck` | exit 0 | | `pnpm lint` | exit 0 | `3de7508e` (system-context row) and `f91b2a1d` (actions-as-tools page) add only docs on top of `056f314d`; the package suites were not rerun for them.
Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands; reconciled with --ran) `dispatch-gates --ran` at `f91b2a1d`: **100 derived, 100 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.** Record: `gates-ran-f91b2a1d.list` in the seat's `out/32163/`. The docs-family gates (31, `check:role-word` and `check:system-context-census` among them) were rerun at `f91b2a1d`; the rest were run at `3de7508e`, which differs from it by one docs page. - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3: its positive control is pinned to commit `621a4876`, which the shallow clone did not hold. After `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` it passes (48 cases). - `pnpm check:system-context-census` was red at the first gate run: the mark's system-context skip is an elevation read no row owned. Fixed in `3de7508e` with row 62b on `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` and the regenerated register; green after. - `pnpm check:role-word` was red on the first wording of that row ("membership role"); the row now says "membership grade". Green after. - The docs edit added 31 docs-family gates to the derivation; all were run at the new tree.
